subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**principle.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the blank will refer to the information mentioned earlier in the passage.
 
• The earlier information in line 1 is : It is said that Archimedes used **huge mirrors to focus the heat of the sun’s rays on enemy ships to burn them**.
 
• **Thus, this is a type of process or guiding belief.**
 
• **Therefore, among the given options, the correct word to use is "principle."** 
 
 
• "Principle" refers to a fundamental truth or guiding belief.(सिद्धांत)
 
 
• Example: Honesty is a principle that should be upheld in all situations.
 
 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Verity" means truth or accuracy.(सचाई)
 
• "Supposition" means an assumption or hypothesis.(अनुमान)
 
• "Moral" refers to a lesson or code of conduct.(नैतिक)
 
• "Verity" and "supposition" are both related to ideas of truth, but they have different connotations.
 
• "Moral" is related to ethical or behavioral guidelines, but it is not as closely related to the idea of a fundamental truth or belief.
